1.  eClerx - Financial Analyst May 2025 - May 2026 
(eClerx provides specialized business process management, automation, and analytics services, primarily serving Fortune 2000 companies in 
financial services, digital marketing, cable & telecom, fashion, and retail. They help clients optimize operations, improve customer experiences, and 
manage data) 
Trade Confirmation 
• Executed trade confirmation and booking validation by matching trade details with counterparties via DTCC RTTM (Real Time Trade 
Matching) and verifying trade bookings in Legacy and BigMac, ensuring accuracy, consistency of trade economics, and timely settlement. 
Trade Settlement 
• Supported Middle Office operations for Morgan Stanley, managing the end-to-end trade lifecycle from confirmation to settlement while utilizing 
7+ platforms—including DTCC (CTM/DTC), Euroclear, RTTM, Safeguard, Qwest, Intellimatch, and BigMac—to process 500+ Fixed Income 
derivative trades (OTC) daily, coordinate with settlement teams and custodians, and ensure timely T+1/T+2 settlements with zero processing 
errors. 
• Supported cross-border settlements through Euroclear, handling failed trades and ensuring timely resolution. 
Exception Management 
• Conducted root cause analysis of aged breaks and liaised with broker-dealers, trading desks, custodians, and clients to resolve settlement breaks 
and manage exceptions, reduce trade fails, enhance settlement efficiency, and minimize operational risk. 
• Investigated and resolved Depot/Nostro, cash, and position breaks through trade reconciliation, validation of settlement instructions, and 
Bloomberg-assisted verification of net settlement amounts. 
• Collaborated with clients through periodic review calls to assess aged breaks, provide operational insights, and agree on corrective actions to 
reduce settlement exceptions and improve operational efficiency. 
Account Reconciliation 
• Performed end-to-end reconciliation of aged Cost Center breaks, conducting root cause analysis and driving timely resolution of reconciliation 
exceptions. 
• Executed post-settlement journal entries to reconcile suspense accounts and maintain financial and accounting accuracy. 
• Coordinated DTCC broker-to-broker position transfers, reconciling position movements with clients to ensure accurate settlement records. 
• Investigated and resolved Security Payment Order (SPO) differences by reconciling payment discrepancies and coordinating recoveries through 
DTC and wire transfers. 
Management Reporting 
• Produced comprehensive EOD MIS reports for 200+ daily Fixed Income transactions, reporting receivable/payable trade values, quantities, 
pending settlement breaks, and KRIs to senior management, enabling proactive escalations, effective settlement risk management, and timely 
resolution of exceptions. 
Leadership & Stakeholder Management 
• Mentored junior analysts on trade settlement, reconciliation, and operational best practices, driving process efficiency and maintaining high 
standards of accuracy. 
• Demonstrated strong stakeholder management by effectively communicating with clients and successfully taking ownership of two additional 
processes, contributing to improved operational efficiency and service delivery.

• Supported tax preparation teams during peak season by assisting with return reviews, resolving issues, and ensuring timely filings. 
• Assisted in tax planning and provided recommendations to maximize client benefits.
